title: Kerning
description: Spacing adjustment between individual letter pairs.
guidance: Distinguish pair adjustments from tracking across a range of text.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Optical centre
description: The location that appears visually centred.
guidance: Inspect asymmetric icons and shapes in their intended container.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Tabular numbers
description: Digits that occupy equal horizontal widths.
guidance: Use to align numeric columns and prevent changing digits from shifting content.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Layout shift
description: Visible content changes position after appearing.
guidance: Investigate delayed assets, fonts and unreserved space.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Tracking
description: Uniform letter-spacing adjustment across text.
guidance: Apply in context rather than confusing it with pair-specific kerning.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Optimistic update
description: The interface shows an expected result before server confirmation.
guidance: Plan reconciliation, reversal or recovery when the operation fails.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: x-height
description: The main lowercase body height represented by the letter x.
guidance: Compare apparent size and readability rather than nominal font size alone.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Touch target
description: The area responding to pointer or touch activation.
guidance: Remember that the interactive region can exceed the visible icon.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Leading
description: Distance between consecutive text baselines.
guidance: Set line height for reading conditions and content density.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Origin-aware animation
description: Informal term for motion beginning from its initiating element.
guidance: Use the relationship to make a transition understandable.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: OKLCH
description: A colour model using lightness, chroma and hue.
guidance: Use perceptual palette adjustments and verify contrast separately.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Widow
description: Traditionally a paragraph's final line stranded atop the next page or column.
guidance: In UI discussions clarify whether an isolated final word is meant instead.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Safe area
description: Space avoiding obstruction by device features and system controls.
guidance: Keep essential controls and information within an appropriate usable region.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Stagger
description: Small timing offsets between related animations.
guidance: Use sequence to communicate relationships without delaying essential content.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Line length
description: Horizontal length of a text line.
guidance: Choose a measure suited to font, reading task, language and viewport.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Affordance
description: An action an object or control allows.
guidance: Use signifiers to help users discover the available action.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Combobox
description: An input associated with a popup of choices.
guidance: Distinguish editable and selection-only behaviours and implement their interaction model.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Interruptible animation
description: Motion that responds before its prior transition completes.
guidance: Reverse or retarget smoothly when the user provides new input.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Progressive disclosure
description: Additional detail becomes available when needed.
guidance: Keep essential actions and material information readily available.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.

title: Shared element transition
description: An identifiable element changes size or position across views.
guidance: Preserve continuity without obscuring navigation or blocking interaction.
verification: Use this definition to interpret related findings.
